$description: Component contracts for the ZITO 1950 site. Visual spec: design/DESIGN.md; tokens: design/zito.tokens.json. Source copy: src/data/content.ts; translations: src/data/translations.json; editable catalog: useShop (types in src/data/types.ts).

components.name: Header
components.behaviour: Sticky white bar 72px, logo.svg left, anchor nav Orologi (#orologi), Profumi (#profumi), Storia (#storia), Social (#social), Dove siamo (#contatti); hairline after scroll; focus-trapped mobile menu. Functional outline-SVG shopping-bag button opens Cart; square ink count badge when non-empty; no floating cart button.

components.name: Hero
components.behaviour: Uncropped product photo from admin-configurable catalog.hero, default img/models/tutus-ab-uno.jpg (Tutus ab uno, the most expensive seed model), eager and high priority. Display title Orologiai a Scalea dal 1950 and short factual text; primary ink-filled .btn Scopri la storia (#storia), secondary outlined .btn Edizioni limitate (#edizioni-limitate) and Social (#social).

components.name: Orologi
components.behaviour: #orologi: text-only pillars and 2/3-column catalog grid. Excludes hidden; featured order puts isNew first, then buy, no-buy, out-of-stock, sold, price descending within each group. Hosts CatalogFilters; empty results show a clear-filters action. #edizioni-limitate applies only the limited filter and stays in step with it.

components.name: CatalogFilters
components.behaviour: Outlined Filtri e ordinamento button with ink count badge, result count, Azzera filtri and removable chips. Native <dialog> side sheet (420px right, full screen on mobile): sort radios; Novità / Edizioni limitate, availability, movement, functions, case and price checkboxes with live counts; zero-count options disabled, never-matching options hidden. OR within a group, AND across groups. Esc/backdrop closes; body scroll locked; focus returns to the button.

components.name: ModelCard

props.onOpen: (model: Model, trigger: HTMLElement, variant: number, image: number) => void

components.behaviour: Image/detail controls open ModelDialog at the selected variant/photo; object-fit contain, serif name, small codes, sans price. Top-left Nuovo and Edizione limitata labels: ink fill, white uppercase tracked small type, radius 0; outlined Venduto / Esaurito tags. Positive piecesRemaining on limited editions shows Ancora N pezzi / Ultimo pezzo disponibile; empty or 0 hides the count. Purchase control only for buy.

components.name: ModelDialog
components.behaviour: Native <dialog>: gallery, variants, name, codes, price, labels, remaining pieces, quote, description, specs and buy-only purchase control. Esc/backdrop closes; body scroll locked; focus returns to opener. Recommended selection switches models in place, resets variant/photo, scrolls to top and focuses the new title.

components.name: Recommended
components.behaviour: Scopri anche inside ModelDialog: every other public model in one horizontal row, owner's similar picks first in their order, then by similarity score (movement, functions, case, limited status, price closeness). Prev/next buttons page by whole cards and disable at the ends; vertical wheel scrolls the row and releases at the ends; touch snap. About two cards visible on mobile, four on desktop; uncropped photos, names, prices and labels. Selection calls onSelect without closing the dialog.

components.name: Profumi
components.behaviour: #profumi: N°7 Oud image and source text from catalog.perfume; omitted when the perfume is removed.

components.name: Storia
components.behaviour: #storia: opens with Scalea e la Calabria and real photographs img/storia/scalea-borgo.jpg and img/storia/scalea-palazzo.jpg, then chronological chapters. Narrow reading columns, optional chapter images alternating sides on desktop, single-column reading below 768px.

components.name: Social
components.behaviour: #social: Instagram and Facebook external link rows separated by hairlines, with whole-row tap targets; no embedded feed.

components.name: Contatti
components.behaviour: Dove siamo at #contatti: company and postal address in <address>, P.IVA, lazy map, Google Maps link and PEC mailto: row. No phone; social links belong to Social.

components.name: Cart
components.behaviour: Native <dialog> opened from Header; quantities, total, PayPal approval and explicit capture confirmation. Certificato personalizzato toggle reveals required Nome, Cognome, Email; sends certificate { firstName, lastName, email } or null to POST /api/payments/orders. Off uses PayPal payer name/email from capture; owner assigns the code in Admin → Ordini.

components.name: Footer
components.behaviour: White footer, hairline top, logo-mark, legal name GRANALIDA s.r.l., nav repeat.
